project_info.theme: Annoyed Valentine beauty portrait with red satin styling
project_info.creative_direction: High-key cosmetic editorial using a frustrated expression, crimson beauty details, and a handwritten card prop
project_info.color_palette: white, saturated red, deep burgundy, warm skin, ruby crystal, and glossy red nails

main_subject.detail: adult woman with dark brown hair slicked into a low bun, furrowed brows, annoyed but composed gaze, natural skin glow, and refined eye makeup
main_subject.wardrobe: red satin off-shoulder corset-style top, bare neck and shoulders, ruby crystal drop earrings, red crystal ring, and red manicure
main_subject.action: holding a white card beside the mouth with one hand; do not bite the card

composition_elements.framing: strict frontal eye-level symmetrical beauty close-up with centered face and card in the lower-right foreground
composition_elements.card: white card with fictional handwritten text VALENTINE NOTES and a single abstract red heart mark; no profanity, brand, or personal name
composition_elements.beauty_details: bold red lipstick, refined eye makeup, natural pores, soft facial glow, and a small number of editorial red graphic marks limited to the card and background

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: Hasselblad X2D-style beauty dish at approximately 5200K with soft frontal fill
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: even high-key cosmetic light, controlled satin sheen, crisp ruby highlights, and realistic skin texture

technical_specs.render_style: Hasselblad X2D-style camera with 105mm lens, frontal beauty portrait
technical_specs.finish: cosmetic advertising detail, visible pores, restrained retouching, clean whites, and no artificial smoothing

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic high-key studio beauty portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman with model-like facial proportions, dark brown hair slicked smoothly into a low bun, furrowed brows, and an annoyed but composed editorial gaze. Use a strict frontal eye-level symmetrical composition on a Hasselblad X2D-style camera with a 105mm lens and approximately 5200K beauty-dish lighting with soft fill. Give her bold red lipstick, refined eye makeup, natural skin pores and glow, ruby red crystal drop earrings, a red crystal ring, and red nail polish. Dress her in a red satin off-shoulder corset-style top. She holds a white card beside her mouth with one hand but does not bite it; the card reads VALENTINE NOTES in fictional red handwriting with one abstract heart mark. Do not include a celebrity likeness, profanity, kiss marks on skin, real names, logos, or personal data. Keep the expression frustrated, fashion-editorial, and non-sexual.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, celebrity likeness, real person name, profanity, kiss marks on face or neck, biting card, real logo, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed hands, illegible card text
